about: Arms of step-look-step (steplook.py, step.sh). bursts = [seconds, the furthest it has been seen to move, m]: the planner never picks a burst that could pass the stop. Round 2 (2026-11-22): the robot carries the 3000 mAh backpack (battery-v2m5-20261121). The step015_v2m5 table (round 3; step045n_v2m5, round 4, replaced it in the experiment on 2026-11-23) is the robot-brain sim's furthest per duration over 7 conditions (cmu/step/results/round2/runtime_bursts_candidate.json); replace it with servo odometry from the first robot logs (odom_report.py). walk61's table is from the old body; on this body walk61 creeps backward at zero command in the sim. rcn030_w918 (round 7, 2026-11-23, 918 g body) replaced step045n_v2m5 in the experiment; its table is the furthest per duration over 10 brain-sim conditions x 8 seeds (results/round7/runtime_bursts_rcn030.json); bursts under 0.8 s are left out because they went backward up to 6 cm. 2026-11-24: rcn030_w918's table is from the robot (its bursts_source); with the sim's table the loop overshot the 18 cm stop and ended 6-16 cm from the ball.
